# Game Optimization Skill

## Purpose
This skill helps improve gameplay experience by analyzing:
- Player score progression
- Collision frequency
- Game speed and difficulty

## Instructions
When invoked:
1. Analyze given game parameters (score, collisions, speed)
2. Identify issues in balancing
3. Suggest improvements in:
- Difficulty scaling
- Obstacle frequency
- Power-up usage

## Examples

### Input
score: 120 
collisions: 8 
speed: 3 

### Output
- Reduce obstacle frequency 
- Improve jump timing 
- Gradually increase speed 

---

### Input
score: 700 
collisions: 1 
speed: 8 

### Output
- Increase difficulty 
- Add more obstacles 
- Introduce advanced power-ups
